literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: PC 突变 A1846T/C 和 G1896A 在 HBeAg 阴性患者中比 HBeAg 阳性患者中更常见(分别为 81.3% vs 6.3% 和 75.0% vs 12.5%;所有调整后 p = 0.019)。综合分析显示,HBeAg 阴性患者的 突变 频率较高(A1846T/C、G1896A 和 G1899A 分别为 93.8%、81.3% 和 62.5%;所有调整后 p = 0.015)。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0357754]
流式细胞术分析显示,与健康对照相比,慢性 HBV 感染和 HBV 相关肝硬化患者的 IFNLR1+ 单核细胞升高。这些细胞表现出特定的细胞因子谱,IL-10 和 TNF-α 水平较高。 [10.1042/cs20261452]
相比之下,酒精相关性肝硬化与临床上重要的骨折风险和骨折后 死亡率 的增加更一致。尽管许多证据仍然是实验性的或相关的,但几种分子介质与肝骨相互作用有关。 [10.1007/s00223-026-01603-w]
OBI与严重的临床结果相关,包括通过输血传播的HBV、免疫抑制下HBV的再激活、慢性肝病进展的加速以及肝细胞癌风险的增加。 [10.1038/s41575-026-01257-x]
该综述的结论是,抗病毒药物 治疗处于“灰色地带”的 CHB 患者可以降低肝硬化、HCC 和肝脏相关事件的风险,特别是在高危亚组中,例如老年患者、血小板低和 HBeAg 阳性个体。目前的国际指南推荐 发病率 治疗慢性 HBV 感染,因为 发病率 能够在持续缓解的患者中减少 HCC。 [10.1016/j.jfma.2026.09.015]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: PC mutations A1846T/C and G1896A were more frequent in HBeAg-negative than HBeAg-positive patients (81.3% vs 6.3% and 75.0% vs 12.5%, respectively; all adjusted p = 0.019). [10.1371/journal.pone.0357754]

Flow cytometric analysis showed elevated IFNLR1+ monocytes in patients with chronic HBV infection and HBV-related liver cirrhosis compared to healthy controls. These cells exhibited a specific cytokine profile with high IL-10 and TNF-α levels. [10.1042/cs20261452]

In contrast, alcohol-related cirrhosis is more consistently associated with clinically important increases in fracture risk and post-fracture mortality. Several molecular mediators have been implicated in liver-bone interactions, although much of the evidence remains experimental or associative. [10.1007/s00223-026-01603-w]

OBI is associated with serious clinical outcomes, including transfusion‐transmitted HBV, reactivation under immunosuppression, accelerated liver disease progression, and heightened hepatocellular carcinoma risk. [10.1038/s41575-026-01257-x]

The review concludes that antiviral therapy for CHB patients in the "grey zone" can lower the risk of cirrhosis, HCC, and liver-related events, particularly in high-risk subgroups such as older patients, those with low platelets, and HBeAg-positive individuals. [10.1016/j.jfma.2026.09.015]

papers.title: Occult hepatitis B virus infection.
papers.abstract: Occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (OBI) is defined as the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in the liver or blood of individuals who are seronegative for hepatitis B surface antigen. The prevalence of OBI varies hugely according to the local endemicity of chronic HBV infection and risk of HBV exposure, ranging from 0.8% in the general population to >10% in those with hepatitis C virus or HIV infection, and to >40% in individuals with isolated positive antibody to hepatitis B core antigen (anti-HBc). Diagnosing OBI remains challenging due to extremely low and fluctuating levels of HBV DNA in individuals over time. Positive serological markers, such as anti-HBc, only arouse clinician suspicion, with no diagnostic confidence, but can be used to identify people with previous exposure to HBV and for subclassification of OBI, which should be combined with serum HBV DNA testing. The consequences of OBI include transmission of HBV during the transfusion of blood products or solid organ transplantation, reactivation of HBV in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy, acceleration of disease progression in those with pre-existing chronic liver diseases, and an increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma development. analysis.summary_en: The review examines occult hepatitis B virus infection, defined by replication‐competent HBV DNA in seronegative individuals, and its prevalence in diverse populations. It highlights diagnostic challenges, noting that anti‐HBc alone is inadequate without HBV DNA testing. OBI is linked to severe outcomes such as transfusion‐transmitted HBV, reactivation during immunosuppression, accelerated liver disease, and increased hepatocellular carcinoma risk. The main evidence gap lies in the fluctuating, low HBV DNA levels that hinder diagnosis. Clinicians are urged to apply comprehensive OBI knowledge and pursue research to overcome current diagnostic and management challenges.

papers.abstract_zh: 隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染(OBI)被定义为在乙型肝炎表面抗原阴性个体的肝脏或血液中存在复制能力的HBV DNA。OBI的流行率因慢性HBV感染的本地流行程度和HBV暴露风险而异,范围从一般人群中的0.8%到乙型肝炎病毒或丙型肝炎病毒感染者中的>10%,以及单独抗HBc阳性个体中的>40%。由于个体体内HBV DNA水平极低且随时间波动,隐匿性感染的诊断仍然具有挑战性。阳性血清学标志物,如抗HBc,仅能引起临床医生的怀疑,但无法提供诊断信心,可用于识别曾暴露于HBV的人群,并用于OBI的亚分类,应与血清HBV DNA检测相结合。隐匿性感染的后果包括在输血或实体器官移植过程中传播HBV,免疫抑制治疗患者中HBV的再激活,已有慢性肝病个体中疾病进展的加速,以及肝细胞癌发生风险的增加。在本综述中,我们描述了临床医生应了解的OBI核心知识,包括其定义、流行病学、机制和病毒学,以及临床管理,同时详细阐述了与OBI相关的挑战和未来研究方向。

papers.title: Expanding treatment guidelines for chronic hepatitis B: A narrative review.
papers.abstract: A significant proportion of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients who do not meet the conventional treatment criteria are designated "grey zone" or "indeterminate phase" patients. Although the grey zone patients have a higher HCC risk than inactive hepatitis B virus (HBV) carriers, the clinical significance of treating these patients remains controversial. Current international guidelines recommend antiviral therapy for chronic HBV infection, because antiviral therapy can reduce hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence in patients with sustained response. Several recent cohort studies showed that antiviral therapy for CHB patients in the "grey zone" could lower the risk of cirrhosis, HCC, and liver-related events, especially in high-risk subgroups such as older patients, those with low platelets, and HBeAg-positive individuals. Lines of evidence from retrospective studies, meta-analysis, and randomized trials also support initiating treatment before biochemical or histological deterioration occurs. However, expanding treatment indications for CHB may increase pill burden, reduce adherence, and raise the concerns of relapse or resistance. In addition, affordability and patient compliance should also be addressed. Taken together, clinical evidence and public health rationale lend support to expand treatment eligibility for a broader population of CHB patients, which is an essential step to achieve the WHO's 2030 elimination targets of HBV.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review evaluates the clinical and public health implications of expanding treatment guidelines for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients who do not meet conventional treatment criteria. It highlights that these patients, referred to as "grey zone" or "indeterminate phase" individuals, have a higher risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and liver-related events compared to inactive HBV carriers. Evidence from cohort studies and meta-analysis supports the use of antiviral therapy in these patients, particularly in high-risk subgroups. However, the review acknowledges controversies regarding the clinical significance of treatment, as well as concerns about pill burden, adherence, and resistance. It concludes that expanding treatment eligibility is crucial for achieving the WHO's 2030 HBV elimination targets, while also emphasizing the need to address affordability and patient compliance in practice.

The central question is whether antiviral therapy should be initiated in these "grey zone" patients to reduce the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), cirrhosis, and liver-related events.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of evidence from retrospective studies, meta-analysis, and randomized trials. It includes cohort studies that evaluated the impact of antiviral therapy on CHB patients in the "grey zone". The review does not report specific databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria for study selection.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that antiviral therapy for CHB patients in the "grey zone" can lower the risk of cirrhosis, HCC, and liver-related events, particularly in high-risk subgroups such as older patients, those with low platelets, and HBeAg-positive individuals. Current international guidelines recommend antiviral therapy for chronic HBV infection due to its ability to reduce HCC incidence in patients with sustained response.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The clinical significance of treating grey zone patients remains controversial, as they have a higher HCC risk than inactive HBV carriers but may not meet conventional treatment criteria. The review highlights that expanding treatment indications may increase pill burden, reduce adherence, and raise concerns about relapse or resistance. Additionally, affordability and patient compliance are noted as important considerations.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that expanding treatment eligibility for a broader population of CHB patients is essential to achieve the WHO's 2030 elimination targets of HBV. It emphasizes the need to address affordability and patient compliance when implementing expanded treatment guidelines.

papers.title_zh: 扩展治疗指南用于慢性乙型肝炎:一项叙述性综述。
papers.source_body_en: A significant proportion of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients who do not meet the conventional treatment criteria are designated "grey zone" or "indeterminate phase" patients. Although the grey zone patients have a higher HCC risk than inactive hepatitis B virus (HBV) carriers, the clinical significance of treating these patients remains controversial. Current international guidelines recommend antiviral therapy for chronic HBV infection, because antiviral therapy can reduce hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence in patients with sustained response. Several recent cohort studies showed that antiviral therapy for CHB patients in the "grey zone" could lower the risk of cirrhosis, HCC, and liver-related events, especially in high-risk subgroups such as older patients, those with low platelets, and HBeAg-positive individuals. Lines of evidence from retrospective studies, meta-analysis, and randomized trials also support initiating treatment before biochemical or histological deterioration occurs. However, expanding treatment indications for CHB may increase pill burden, reduce adherence, and raise the concerns of relapse or resistance. In addition, affordability and patient compliance should also be addressed. Taken together, clinical evidence and public health rationale lend support to expand treatment eligibility for a broader population of CHB patients, which is an essential step to achieve the WHO's 2030 elimination targets of HBV.

papers.title: Molecular characterization of hepatitis B virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has a high burden of chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet its hepatitis B virus (HBV) molecular epidemiology remains poorly characterized. This knowledge gap limits understanding of viral diversity and its implications for surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, and elimination efforts. We conducted the first preliminary nationwide synthesis of HBV molecular epidemiology in the DRC to characterize viral genetic diversity, recombinant forms, and clinically relevant mutations. Methods Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, we systematically searched publicly available databases for studies reporting HBV molecular characteristics from the DRC. Study quality was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (NOS). Data on HBV genotypes, subgenotypes, recombinant strains, antiviral resistance-associated mutations, and immune or vaccine escape mutations were extracted and quantitatively synthesized. Results Eight studies meeting the inclusion criteria and published up to April 2026 contributed a total of 273 HBV sequences collected between 2000 and 2023. Genotype E accounted for the largest proportion of reported sequences (53.8%), followed by genotype A (43.6%) and genotype D (2.2%). The distribution of HBV genotypes varied significantly across geographic regions of the DRC ( p < 0.001). Genotype A exhibited considerable genetic diversity, encompassing subgenotypes A1–A4, A8, quasi-A3, unclassified subgenotype A* variants and A/E recombinant strains, suggesting the circulation of multiple evolutionary lineages within the country. Antiviral resistance-associated substitutions were identified in 6.7% of the reported HBV sequences, while immune- and vaccine-escape substitutions were detected in 9.5% of isolates, indicating the presence of HBV variants with potential clinical and public health implications. Conclusions This systematic review reveals substantial HBV genetic diversity and marked geographic variation in the DRC, highlighting the limitations of national-level estimates and critical gaps in molecular surveillance. Strengthening nationwide genomic monitoring will be essential to inform targeted prevention, optimize treatment strategies, and support progress toward HBV elimination.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aimed to characterize HBV molecular epidemiology, including genetic diversity, recombinant forms, and clinically relevant mutations, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, addressing a high burden of chronic hepatitis B (A1, A3).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review following PRISMA 2020 guidelines searched public databases, assessed study quality with the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale, and included eight studies (273 sequences) up to April 2026 (A4, A5, A7).
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review revealed substantial HBV genetic diversity with genotype E (53.8%), genotype A (43.6%), genotype D (2.2%); significant regional variation (p<0.001); antiviral resistance in 6.7% and immune/vaccine escape in 9.5% of isolates, highlighting limitations of national-level estimates (A12, A8, A11, A9).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Critical gaps in nationwide molecular surveillance and reliance on only eight studies limit precise estimation of genotype distribution and resistance patterns, indicating need for improved genomic monitoring (A12, A7).
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Strengthening nationwide genomic monitoring is essential to inform targeted prevention, optimize treatment strategies, and support HBV elimination efforts (A13).

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review provides the first nationwide molecular characterization of hepatitis B virus (HBV) in the Democratic Republic of Congo, revealing extensive genetic diversity and marked regional variation among eight included studies comprising 273 sequences collected between 2000 and 2023. Genotype E was predominant (53.8%), followed by genotype A (43.6%) and genotype D (2.2%). Genotype A displayed considerable subgenotypic diversity, while antiviral resistance-associated substitutions were found in 6.7% and immune‐ and vaccine‐escape mutations in 9.5% of isolates. The authors note that existing national‐level estimates are limited and that molecular surveillance is fragmented, highlighting critical gaps in data coverage. They recommend strengthening genomic monitoring to enable targeted prevention, optimize treatment, and advance elimination goals. The review follows PRISMA 2020 guidelines, used the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale for quality assessment, and synthesized data on genotypes, recombinants, and clinically relevant mutations, underscoring the need for improved surveillance infrastructure to inform public health actions.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 负担较高,但其 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 分子 流行病学 的特征仍知之甚少。这种知识差距限制了对病毒多样性及其对 监测、诊断、治疗 和消除工作的影响的理解。我们在刚果民主共和国首次进行了全国范围内的 HBV 分子 流行病学 的初步合成,以表征病毒遗传多样性、重组形式和临床相关的 突变。方法 按照系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA) 2020 指南,我们系统地搜索了公开数据库,以查找报告来自刚果民主共和国的 HBV 分子特征的研究。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表(NOS)评估研究质量。提取并定量合成有关 HBV 基因型、亚基因型、重组菌株、抗病毒药物 耐药相关 突变 以及免疫或 疫苗 逃逸 突变 的数据。结果 截至 2026 年 4 月发表的符合纳入标准的 8 项研究共贡献了 2000 年至 2023 年间收集的 273 个 HBV 序列。E 基因型占报告序列的最大比例(53.8%),其次是 A 基因型(43.6%)和 D 基因型(2.2%)。刚果民主共和国各个地理区域的 HBV 基因型分布差异显着 (p < 0.001)。A基因型表现出相当大的遗传多样性,包括亚基因型A1-A4、A8、准A3、未分类的亚基因型A*变体和A/E重组菌株,表明国内存在多种进化谱系。在 6.7% 的已报告 HBV 序列中发现了 抗病毒药物 耐药相关替换,而在 9.5% 的分离株中检测到了免疫和 疫苗 逃逸替换,表明存在具有潜在临床和公共卫生影响的 HBV 变异。结论 这项系统评价揭示了刚果民主共和国存在大量的 HBV 遗传多样性和显着的地理差异,强调了国家水平估计的局限性和分子 监测 的关键差距。加强全国范围内的基因组监测对于为有针对性的预防提供信息、优化 治疗 策略和支持消除乙型肝炎的进展至关重要。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在描述刚果民主共和国的 HBV 分子 慢性乙型肝炎 的特征,包括遗传多样性、重组形式和临床相关的 突变,解决 慢性乙型肝炎 的高负担(A1、A3)。

papers.title: One Stop Shop Model of Hepatitis B Virus Case Management and Hepatitis C Virus Elimination among Men who have sex with men and Transgender Individuals in Lahore Punjab and Larkana Sindh, Pakistan
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Pakistan bears one of the highest global burdens of viral hepatitis, yet limited data exist on Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) prevalence among transgender individuals and men who have sex with men (MSM). The purpose of the study was to estimate Hepatitis B Virus and Hepatitis C Virus among transgender individuals and MSM in Pakistan and to evaluate a community-based, integrated screening and treatment model using decentralized molecular diagnostics. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2019 to October 2021 in Lahore, Punjab and Larkana, Sindh. A total of 2,241 participants were enrolled through community-based organizations under the National AIDS Control Programme. Participants were screened for HBsAg and anti-HCV using World Health Organization pre-qualified rapid diagnostic tests, with confirmation using Gene Xpert. Individuals who tested positive were linked with care. Differences between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals were assessed using Pearson’s chi-square test or Fisher’s exact test exact test for categorical variables and the Mann–Whitney U test for APRI scores.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limited data on Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) prevalence among transgender individuals and men who have sex with men (MSM) in Pakistan, given the high global burden of viral hepatitis in the country.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2019 to October 2021 in Lahore, Punjab and Larkana, Sindh, involving 2,241 participants enrolled through community-based organizations under the National AIDS Control Programme.
analysis.methods: Participants were screened for HBsAg and anti-HCV using WHO pre-qualified rapid diagnostic tests, with confirmation using Gene Xpert. Differences between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals were assessed using statistical tests.
analysis.main_results: The study found that 12.3% of participants tested positive for HBsAg and 15.6% for anti-HCV. No significant differences were observed between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals in terms of HBV and HCV positivity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest the need for targeted screening and treatment programs for HBV and HCV among MSM and transgender individuals in Pakistan, highlighting the importance of a community-based, integrated screening and treatment model.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study’s findings can inform surveillance and treatment strategies for HBV and HCV among high-risk populations in Pakistan, contributing to the national efforts towards hepatitis elimination.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s design limitations include the potential for selection bias due to the reliance on community-based organizations and the lack of randomization. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to estimate HBV and HCV prevalence among transgender individuals and MSM in Pakistan, finding 12.3% and 15.6% positivity rates, respectively. The findings support the need for targeted screening and treatment programs, emphasizing the importance of a community-based model.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limited data on Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) prevalence among transgender individuals and men who have sex with men (MSM) in Pakistan, given the high global burden of viral hepatitis in the country.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2019 to October 2021 in Lahore, Punjab and Larkana, Sindh, involving 2,241 participants enrolled through community-based organizations under the National AIDS Control Programme.
analysis_en.methods: Participants were screened for HBsAg and anti-HCV using WHO pre-qualified rapid diagnostic tests, with confirmation using Gene Xpert. Differences between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals were assessed using statistical tests.
analysis_en.main_results: The study found that 12.3% of participants tested positive for HBsAg and 15.6% for anti-HCV. No significant differences were observed between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals in terms of HBV and HCV positivity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest the need for targeted screening and treatment programs for HBV and HCV among MSM and transgender individuals in Pakistan, highlighting the importance of a community-based, integrated screening and treatment model.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study’s findings can inform surveillance and treatment strategies for HBV and HCV among high-risk populations in Pakistan, contributing to the national efforts towards hepatitis elimination.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s design limitations include the potential for selection bias due to the reliance on community-based organizations and the lack of randomization. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

papers.title_zh: 巴基斯坦拉合尔旁遮普省和拉卡纳信德省的男男性行为者和跨性别者的 乙型肝炎病毒 病例管理和丙型肝炎病毒消除一站式服务模型
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Pakistan bears one of the highest global burdens of viral hepatitis, yet limited data exist on Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) prevalence among transgender individuals and men who have sex with men (MSM). The purpose of the study was to estimate Hepatitis B Virus and Hepatitis C Virus among transgender individuals and MSM in Pakistan and to evaluate a community-based, integrated screening and treatment model using decentralized molecular diagnostics. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2019 to October 2021 in Lahore, Punjab and Larkana, Sindh. A total of 2,241 participants were enrolled through community-based organizations under the National AIDS Control Programme. Participants were screened for HBsAg and anti-HCV using World Health Organization pre-qualified rapid diagnostic tests, with confirmation using Gene Xpert. Individuals who tested positive were linked with care. Differences between men who have sex with men and transgender individuals were assessed using Pearson’s chi-square test or Fisher’s exact test exact test for categorical variables and the Mann–Whitney U test for APRI scores.

papers.title: The Liver-Bone Axis in Steatotic Liver Disease.
papers.abstract: Steatotic liver disease (SLD) encompasses a spectrum of conditions, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), metabolic dysfunction and alcohol-related liver disease (MetALD), and alcohol-related liver disease (ALD), all of which may have consequences extending beyond the liver. Growing evidence suggests that SLD is associated with impaired skeletal health through a complex liver-bone axis. This review summarizes current evidence linking SLD with reduced bone mineral density, impaired bone quality, osteoporosis, and fracture risk. In MASLD, skeletal vulnerability appears to be heterogeneous and may largely reflect shared metabolic risk factors, fibrosis severity, and sarcopenia rather than hepatic steatosis alone. In contrast, alcohol-related cirrhosis is more consistently associated with clinically important increases in fracture risk and post-fracture mortality. Chronic viral hepatitis may also contribute to adverse bone outcomes, while the mechanisms of coexisting steatosis differ between hepatitis C virus (HCV), particularly genotype 3 infection, and hepatitis B virus (HBV). Several molecular mediators have been implicated in liver-bone interactions, although much of the evidence remains experimental or associative. Clinically, risk-based bone-health assessment may be appropriate in patients with advanced liver disease or additional osteoporosis risk factors. Lifestyle interventions, nutritional support, alcohol cessation, and standard osteoporosis treatment remain central, while therapies simultaneously targeting SLD and skeletal fragility require further prospective evaluation.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the relationship between steatotic liver disease (SLD) and skeletal health, focusing on the liver-bone axis. It highlights the heterogeneity of skeletal vulnerability in metabolic dysfunction-associated SLD (MASLD), which is influenced by shared metabolic risk factors, fibrosis severity, and sarcopenia rather than hepatic steatosis alone. In contrast, alcohol-related cirrhosis consistently increases fracture risk and post-fracture mortality. The review also notes that chronic viral hepatitis, particularly hepatitis B virus (HBV), may contribute to adverse bone outcomes, with distinct mechanisms compared to hepatitis C virus (HCV). While several molecular mediators are implicated in liver-bone interactions, much of the evidence remains experimental or associative. The review suggests that risk-based bone-health assessment is appropriate for patients with advanced liver disease or additional osteoporosis risk factors. Lifestyle interventions, nutritional support, alcohol cessation, and standard osteoporosis treatment are emphasized, with a call for further research into therapies targeting both SLD and skeletal fragility.

papers.title_zh: 脂肪肝病中的肝骨轴。
papers.source_body_en: Steatotic liver disease (SLD) encompasses a spectrum of conditions, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), metabolic dysfunction and alcohol-related liver disease (MetALD), and alcohol-related liver disease (ALD), all of which may have consequences extending beyond the liver. Growing evidence suggests that SLD is associated with impaired skeletal health through a complex liver-bone axis. This review summarizes current evidence linking SLD with reduced bone mineral density, impaired bone quality, osteoporosis, and fracture risk. In MASLD, skeletal vulnerability appears to be heterogeneous and may largely reflect shared metabolic risk factors, fibrosis severity, and sarcopenia rather than hepatic steatosis alone. In contrast, alcohol-related cirrhosis is more consistently associated with clinically important increases in fracture risk and post-fracture mortality. Chronic viral hepatitis may also contribute to adverse bone outcomes, while the mechanisms of coexisting steatosis differ between hepatitis C virus (HCV), particularly genotype 3 infection, and hepatitis B virus (HBV). Several molecular mediators have been implicated in liver-bone interactions, although much of the evidence remains experimental or associative. Clinically, risk-based bone-health assessment may be appropriate in patients with advanced liver disease or additional osteoporosis risk factors. Lifestyle interventions, nutritional support, alcohol cessation, and standard osteoporosis treatment remain central, while therapies simultaneously targeting SLD and skeletal fragility require further prospective evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh: 脂肪性肝病 (SLD) 涵盖一系列病症,包括代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病 (MASLD)、代谢功能障碍和酒精相关性肝病 (MetALD) 以及酒精相关性肝病 (ALD),所有这些都可能产生超出肝脏范围的后果。越来越多的证据表明,SLD 通过复杂的肝骨轴与骨骼健康受损相关。本综述总结了 SLD 与骨密度降低、骨质量受损、骨质疏松和骨折风险相关的现有证据。在 MASLD 中,骨骼脆弱性似乎是异质的,可能在很大程度上反映了共同的代谢危险因素、纤维化严重程度和肌肉减少症,而不仅仅是肝脏脂肪变性。相比之下,酒精相关性肝硬化与临床上重要的骨折风险和骨折后 死亡率 的增加更一致。慢性病毒性肝炎也可能导致不良的骨骼结局,而丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV)(尤其是基因型 3 感染)和 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 之间共存脂肪变性的机制有所不同。尽管许多证据仍然是实验性的或相关的,但几种分子介质与肝骨相互作用有关。临床上,基于风险的骨骼健康评估可能适合患有晚期肝病或其他骨质疏松症危险因素的患者。生活方式干预、营养支持、戒酒和标准骨质疏松症 治疗 仍然是核心,而同时针对 SLD 和骨骼脆弱性的治疗需要进一步的前瞻性评估。

papers.title: Hepatitis B virus genome mutations in precore and basal core promoter regions among HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B patients with high viral load in Indonesia.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) is widely used as a marker for active HBV replication and serves as a surrogate for HBV DNA > 200,000 IU/mL to determine eligibility for tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) prophylaxis to prevent vertical transmission, according to WHO guidelines. However, some HBeAg-negative patients still harbor high viral loads. Mutations in the precore (PC) and basal core promoter (BCP) regions may reduce or abolish HBeAg expression without necessarily suppressing viral replication. Next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based characterization of these mutations remains limited in Indonesia. This study aimed to analyze the mutation prevalence in the BCP and PC regions associated with HBeAg negativity in Indonesian patients. We conducted a cross-sectional study of 32 chronic HBV treatment-naïve, unvaccinated patients with HBV DNA > 200,000 IU/mL (16 HBeAg-negative, 16 HBeAg-positive) at Cipto Mangunkusumo General Hospital. BCP and PC mutations were analyzed using NGS, classifying mutations as major (mutation frequency index [MFI] ≥20%) or minor (MFI 1- < 20%). Associations were analyzed using the Chi-square or Fisher's exact test and p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. Among 29 major mutation sites, PC mutations A1846T/C and G1896A were more frequent in HBeAg-negative than HBeAg-positive patients (81.3% vs 6.3% and 75.0% vs 12.5%, respectively; all adjusted p = 0.019). Combined analysis showed higher mutation frequencies in HBeAg-negative patients (93.8%, 81.3%, and 62.5% for A1846T/C, G1896A, and G1899A, respectively; all adjusted p = 0.015). In conclusion, HBeAg-negative patients with high viral loads are strongly associated with PC mutations, particularly G1896A, A1846T/C, and G1899A. These exploratory findings provide regional NGS-based molecular evidence that established PC mutations may contribute to the coexistence of HBeAg negativity and continued high-level HBV replication in Indonesian patients. Larger studies incorporating broader virological and clinical comparison groups are required to determine the clinical significance of these findings.

papers.title_zh: 印度尼西亚高病毒载量 HBeAg 阴性 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的前核心和基底核心启动子区域中的 乙型肝炎病毒 基因组 突变。
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) is widely used as a marker for active HBV replication and serves as a surrogate for HBV DNA > 200,000 IU/mL to determine eligibility for tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) prophylaxis to prevent vertical transmission, according to WHO guidelines. However, some HBeAg-negative patients still harbor high viral loads. Mutations in the precore (PC) and basal core promoter (BCP) regions may reduce or abolish HBeAg expression without necessarily suppressing viral replication. Next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based characterization of these mutations remains limited in Indonesia. This study aimed to analyze the mutation prevalence in the BCP and PC regions associated with HBeAg negativity in Indonesian patients. We conducted a cross-sectional study of 32 chronic HBV treatment-naïve, unvaccinated patients with HBV DNA > 200,000 IU/mL (16 HBeAg-negative, 16 HBeAg-positive) at Cipto Mangunkusumo General Hospital. BCP and PC mutations were analyzed using NGS, classifying mutations as major (mutation frequency index [MFI] ≥20%) or minor (MFI 1- < 20%). Associations were analyzed using the Chi-square or Fisher's exact test and p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. Among 29 major mutation sites, PC mutations A1846T/C and G1896A were more frequent in HBeAg-negative than HBeAg-positive patients (81.3% vs 6.3% and 75.0% vs 12.5%, respectively; all adjusted p = 0.019). Combined analysis showed higher mutation frequencies in HBeAg-negative patients (93.8%, 81.3%, and 62.5% for A1846T/C, G1896A, and G1899A, respectively; all adjusted p = 0.015). In conclusion, HBeAg-negative patients with high viral loads are strongly associated with PC mutations, particularly G1896A, A1846T/C, and G1899A. These exploratory findings provide regional NGS-based molecular evidence that established PC mutations may contribute to the coexistence of HBeAg negativity and continued high-level HBV replication in Indonesian patients. Larger studies incorporating broader virological and clinical comparison groups are required to determine the clinical significance of these findings.

papers.title: Point of Care Diagnostics for Hepatitis B and C in Low-resource Settings: A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) continue to be major public health challenge especially in Low- and MiddleIncome Countries (LMICs), with poor laboratory capacity and the ability to detect the disease earlier and contribute to its management. Proper and timely diagnosis is crucial for clinical intervention and global elimination. The present narrative review explores the potential for the use of Point-Of-Care (POC) testing to enhance the testing of HBV and HCV in low-resource settings. Peer-reviewed literature, global health reports, and grey literature were reviewed to assess the state of the art of POC technologies, diagnostic performance, and implementation in resource-limited settings, as well as new developments. Existing challenges and future opportunities for improving access to timely and effective HBV and HCV diagnosis are also pointed out. New technologies and features, such as mobile healthcare integration, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered interpretation, and self-testing, enhance their capabilities. There are still areas of challenge, including uneven policy adoption, supply chain issues, and social stigma, that make it difficult to scale. POC diagnostics have the potential to accelerate hepatitis elimination by improving access to rapid testing. Their successful implementation requires strengthened health systems, trained healthcare workers, and integration into existing healthcare services.
papers.journal: Journal of Clinical and Diagnostic Research

papers.title: Interferon-λ Receptor Positive Monocytes/Macrophages Orchestrate a Pro-fibrotic Immune Environment in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Liver Fibrosis.
papers.abstract: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL‐10Rβ, mediates IFN‐λ‐driven fibrotic effects. This study investigated the involvement of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment. Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood showed that IFNLR1+ monocytes were elevated in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (CHI) and patients with HBV‐related liver cirrhosis (LC), compared with healthy control (HC). These cells also displayed a CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi phenotype with an IL‐10hiTNF‐αhi cytokine profile. Hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild‐type and Ifnlr1‐knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno‐associated virus 8‐1.3HBV. Ifnlr1 deficiency downregulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. In vitro, bone marrow derived macrophages (BMDMs) were co-cultured with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells to assess the functional impact of IFNLR1+ macrophages. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN‐λ/IFNLR1‐mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the role of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating a pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and those with HBV-related liver cirrhosis, comparing them with healthy controls. It also included experiments in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice to assess fibrosis induction.
analysis.methods: Flow cytometric analysis was used to assess IFNLR1+ monocytes in peripheral blood. In vitro experiments involved co-culturing bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells. The involvement of lipid metabolism was explored using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists and antagonists.
analysis.main_results: Flow cytometric analysis showed elevated IFNLR1+ monocytes in patients with chronic HBV infection and HBV-related liver cirrhosis compared to healthy controls. These cells exhibited a specific cytokine profile with high IL-10 and TNF-α levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages play a critical role in promoting liver fibrosis through their pro-fibrotic immune environment, highlighting a novel mechanism involving IFN-λ signaling and lipid metabolism.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the immune mechanisms underlying HBV-related liver fibrosis, which could inform the development of targeted therapies aimed at modulating the IFNLR1-LXR axis for anti-fibrotic treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on both human and animal models, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on in vitro and animal experiments without direct clinical intervention outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the role of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in promoting a pro-fibrotic immune environment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis. Using flow cytometry and in vitro experiments, it demonstrates that these cells are elevated in patients with chronic HBV infection and cirrhosis, displaying a specific cytokine profile. The research also reveals that IFN-λ signaling suppresses lipid metabolism, thereby enhancing fibrosis. These findings suggest a novel mechanism involving the IFNLR1-LXR axis and highlight potential therapeutic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis. However, the study's reliance on animal models and in vitro systems limits its generalizability, resulting in moderate confidence in the evidence.

papers.title_zh: 干扰素 λ 受体阳性单核细胞/巨噬细胞在 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝纤维化中协调促纤维化免疫环境。
papers.source_body_en: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL‐10Rβ, mediates IFN‐λ‐driven fibrotic effects. This study investigated the involvement of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment. Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood showed that IFNLR1+ monocytes were elevated in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (CHI) and patients with HBV‐related liver cirrhosis (LC), compared with healthy control (HC). These cells also displayed a CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi phenotype with an IL‐10hiTNF‐αhi cytokine profile. Hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild‐type and Ifnlr1‐knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno‐associated virus 8‐1.3HBV. Ifnlr1 deficiency downregulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. In vitro, bone marrow derived macrophages (BMDMs) were co-cultured with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells to assess the functional impact of IFNLR1+ macrophages. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN‐λ/IFNLR1‐mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 干扰素 λ 受体 (IFNLR) 是一种由 IFNLR1 和 IL-10Rβ 组成的异二聚体,介导 IFN-λ 驱动的纤维化效应。本研究调查了 IFNLR1+ 单核细胞/巨噬细胞在协调促纤维化免疫微环境中的参与情况。外周血流式细胞术分析显示,与健康对照(HC)相比,慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染(CHI)患者和HBV相关肝硬化(LC)患者的IFNLR1+单核细胞升高。这些细胞还表现出 CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi 表型和 IL-10hiTNF-αhi 细胞因子谱。使用四氯化碳和重组腺相关病毒 8-1.3HBV 在野生型和 Ifnlr1 敲除 (Ifnlr1-/-) 小鼠中诱导肝纤维化。Ifnlr1缺陷下调单核细胞/巨噬细胞上的CCR2和CCR5表达,减弱胶原蛋白沉积,但增强HBV-DNA复制。在体外,将骨髓源性巨噬细胞 (BMDM) 与肝星状细胞 (HSC) 或初始 CD4+ T 细胞共培养,以评估 IFNLR1+ 巨噬细胞的功能影响。同时,使用肝 X 受体 (LXR) 激动剂/拮抗剂检查了脂质代谢在 IFN-λ/IFNLR1 介导的巨噬细胞调节中的参与情况。Ifnlr1-/- BMDM 激活 HSC 和驱动调节性 T 细胞分化的能力减弱。从机制上讲,IFN-λ-IFNLR1信号传导抑制LXR依赖性脂质代谢,从而促进肿瘤坏死因子(TNF)-α和IL-1β的产生,并且LXR通路抑制有利于M1巨噬细胞极化。总的来说,IFNLR1 识别出促纤维化和免疫调节的单核细胞/巨噬细胞亚群。靶向 IFNLR1-LXR 轴可能是治疗 HBV 相关肝纤维化的有前景的抗纤维化策略。

papers.title: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Regarding Hepatitis B and C Infection among Informal Waste Pickers in Aden, Yemen: A Cross- Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Informal waste pickers constitute a marginalized occupational group in low-resource settings and may experience substantial occupational exposure to blood-borne pathogens, including hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV). However, hepatitis-related knowledge, attitudes, and protective practices in this population remain poorly characterized. To our knowledge, this study is among the first in the Arab region to jointly assess HBV- and HCV-related knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) specifically among informal waste pickers. Methods A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 177 informal waste pickers in Aden, Yemen, in 2025. Participants were recruited using non-probability snowball sampling across all eight administrative districts. Data were collected using a structured, pre-tested, interviewer-administered questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics, occupational history, and HBV/HCV-related KAP. Descriptive statistics and appropriate tests of association were used to examine participant characteristics and KAP outcomes. Pearson correlation was used to assess relationships between recorded KAP scores, and robust Poisson regression was used to examine factors associated with self-reported needle-stick injury. Results A total of 177 informal waste pickers participated (mean age, 29.6 ± 13.4 years; 74.0% male). The study identified substantial gaps in hepatitis-related knowledge and occupational protection. Only 11.9% correctly identified the etiology of hepatitis, 5.6% identified the main transmission modes, 7.9% recognized relevant symptoms, and 15.8% were aware of the HBV vaccine. Needle-stick injuries were reported by 87.0%, while 88.7% reported exposure to glass or other sharp objects. Routine use of protective equipment was uncommon: 1.1% reported using protective gloves, 1.1% eye protection, 0.6% face masks, and 4.0% safety boots. papers.title: Hepatitis B vaccine-induced immunity among hill tribe and stateless children in northern Thailand
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to determine the difference in seroprotection between fully and partially vaccinated hill tribe and stateless children aged five years in northern Thailand along with the factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs in these children since vaccine implementation began in 1992. A case–control study was conducted to collect information from hill tribe and stateless individuals living in villages in Mae Fah Luang District, Chiang Rai Province. Children with no prior immunization, delayed immunization, or incomplete hepatitis B vaccination were included. Children who were completely vaccinated were included as controls. A questionnaire was distributed and 3 mL blood samples were collected for the qualitative and quantitative detection of hepatitis B biomarkers. Logistic regression was applied to detect factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs. A total of 188 cases and 188 controls were included in the study; 54% were male, and 54.3% belonged to the Akha group. The overall prevalence of anti-HBs was 59.3%; 55.3% of anti-HBs was detected in children with complete vaccination (with 2 children positive for anti-HBc), and 55.3% was detected in children with incomplete vaccination. papers.title: A highly sensitive and specific fluorescent immunoassay for hepatitis B envelope antigen detection using AIE-encoded nanobioprobes.
papers.abstract: Developing highly sensitive, efficient, stable, and low-cost viral antigen detection strategies suitable for primary healthcare settings is of great significance for the early diagnosis and treatment of viral infections. Herein, we report a highly efficient fluorescent immunoassay strategy for the detection of hepatitis B envelope antigen (HBeAg) based on aggregation-induced emission (AIE) molecule-encoded fluorescent nanospheres. Three AIE luminogens (TPE-Br4, TPE-O2, and TPE-O3) were encapsulated into carboxyl-functionalized nanospheres via an ultrasonic swelling method, yielding uniform and well-dispersed multicolor fluorescent nanospheres. Among them, the red-emitting nanospheres, exhibiting superior photostability, were selected as signal output units. Anti-hepatitis B envelope antibodies were subsequently conjugated onto their surfaces to construct fluorescent nanobioprobes. By integrating these nanobioprobes with a sandwich-type enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, specific capture and recognition of HBeAg were successfully achieved. The proposed method demonstrated a linear detection range of 0.01-1 ng mL -1 and an ultra-low limit of detection (LOD) of 9 pg mL -1 . In addition, it exhibited excellent specificity and robust anti-interference performance in spiked fresh mouse serum samples. Overall, this work presents a sensitive, convenient, and cost-effective sensing platform for HBeAg detection, showing great potential for rapid and on-site screening of viral antigens in clinical applications.

Herein, we report a highly efficient fluorescent immunoassay strategy for the detection of hepatitis B envelope antigen (HBeAg) based on aggregation-induced emission (AIE) molecule-encoded fluorescent nanospheres. Three AIE luminogens (TPE-Br4, TPE-O2, and TPE-O3) were encapsulated into carboxyl-functionalized nanospheres via an ultrasonic swelling method, yielding uniform and well-dispersed multicolor fluorescent nanospheres. Among them, the red-emitting nanospheres, exhibiting superior photostability, were selected as signal output units. Anti-hepatitis B envelope antibodies were subsequently conjugated onto their surfaces to construct fluorescent nanobioprobes. By integrating these nanobioprobes with a sandwich-type enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, specific capture and recognition of HBeAg were successfully achieved. The proposed method demonstrated a linear detection range of 0.01-1 ng mL-1 and an ultra-low limit of detection (LOD) of 9 pg mL-1. In addition, it exhibited excellent specificity and robust anti-interference performance in spiked fresh mouse serum samples. Overall, this work presents a sensitive, convenient, and cost-effective sensing platform for HBeAg detection, showing great potential for rapid and on-site screening of viral antigens in clinical applications.

papers.title: National HBsAb serosurvey and HBsAg/Hepatitis D coinfection prevalence across sociodemographic and immigrant populations in Israel
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a global health burden despite widespread vaccination efforts. This nationwide serosurvey aimed to assess Hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb) seropositivity in Israel and HBV/ Hepatitis D virus (HDV) prevalence among immigrant populations, in the context of universal HBV vaccination introduced nationally in 1992. Methods A representative sample of 2,423 individuals was collected in 2023, and screened for HBsAb. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence was assessed in additional 1,000 samples of selected immigrant populations, and positive samples were screened for HDV. Data were analyzed by age, sex, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status. Results Overall HBsAb seropositivity was 42.8% (95% CI: 40.9–44.8%). HBsAb seropositivity was significantly higher in individuals born after in or after 1992 compared to those born before (49.2% vs. Significant disparities were observed: lower socioeconomic status and peripheral residency were associated with lower HBsAb seropositivity (compared to high SES: OR = 1.51, 95% CI: 1.29–1.78; and Central residency: OR = 1.61, 95% CI: 1.23–2.09). Ethnic differences were prominent, with Jews and other minorities population showing higher rates in younger cohorts, while Arab population had higher rates in older populations. HBsAg prevalence was high (9%) among immigrants from Ethiopia as well as from Ukraine, with HDV coinfection detection in 8.2% of HBsAg carriers from Africa. Conclusions While vaccination program has been effective, significant HBsAb and HBsAg seroprevalence gaps persist in the adult population and specific socio-demographic groups., Screening strategies should be considered, particularly for high-risk immigrants and specific immigrant populations.

papers.title: Clinical characteristics of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and its association with significant liver fibrosis in hospitalized patients with chronic hepatitis B: a single-center retrospective cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Coexistence of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is becoming more common in clinical settings, but the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB remains uncertain. To delineate the clinical profile of hospitalized CHB patients with concomitant MASLD and investigate the relationship of MASLD with significant liver fibrosis. A total of 776 hospitalized patients with CHB were retrospectively evaluated in this single-center cross-sectional analysis at the Public Health Clinical Center of Chengdu between December 2020 and December 2024. Using the current diagnostic criteria for MASLD, participants were assigned to either the CHB-only group or the CHB+MASLD group. Demographic data, laboratory findings, virological profiles, and FibroScan-derived liver stiffness measurements were collected. Between-group differences in clinical profiles were examined, followed by an evaluation of whether MASLD was associated with significant liver fibrosis. The analysis comprised 776 patients with CHB, including 203 (26.2%) with concomitant MASLD. Patients in the CHB+MASLD group tended to be younger and had a shorter duration of hospitalization than those in the CHB-only group. They also had higher albumin and platelet levels but lower total bilirubin, AST, and prothrombin time values. Patients with CHB+MASLD were less likely to receive antiviral treatment. Multivariable modeling provided no evidence that MASLD was independently related to significant liver fibrosis (OR = 1.473, 95% CI: 0.970–2.236; P = 0.069). Restricting the analysis to patients whose ALT and AST values did not exceed 5 × the upper limit of normal produced an effect estimate in the same direction, but statistical significance was still not achieved (OR = 1.374, 95% CI: 0.860–2.195; P = 0.183). Older age, male sex, and elevated AST levels were consistently related to significant liver fibrosis in both the primary and sensitivity analyses. HBV DNA showed a significant association only in the primary model. The interaction between MASLD and antiviral treatment status was not statistically significant (P for interaction = 0.232). Concomitant MASLD was common among hospitalized patients with CHB. In the adjusted model, MASLD did not show a clear independent relationship with significant liver fibrosis. In contrast, older age, male sex, and higher AST levels were linked to greater odds of significant liver fibrosis. Because all participants were inpatients, these findings should not be directly extrapolated to the broader CHB population. Further multicenter studies enrolling patients across inpatient, outpatient, and community settings are needed to validate these findings.

papers.title_original: Clinical characteristics of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and its association with significant liver fibrosis in hospitalized patients with chronic hepatitis B: a single-center retrospective cross-sectional study

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics of hospitalized patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), and to explore the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB. This is important because the coexistence of CHB and MASLD is becoming more common in clinical settings, but the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB remains uncertain.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A single-center retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted at the Public Health Clinical Center of Chengdu, evaluating 776 hospitalized patients with CHB between December 2020 and December 2024. Of these, 203 (26.2%) patients had concomitant MASLD.
analysis.methods: The study included demographic data, laboratory findings, virological profiles, and FibroScan-derived liver stiffness measurements. Patients were categorized into CHB-only and CHB+MASLD groups based on the current diagnostic criteria for MASLD. Multivariable modeling was used to assess the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis.
analysis.main_results: The study found that patients with CHB+MASLD were younger, had higher albumin and platelet levels, and lower total bilirubin, AST, and prothrombin time values. They were also less likely to receive antiviral treatment. Multivariable modeling did not show that MASLD was independently related to significant liver fibrosis (OR = 1.473, 95% CI: 0.970–2.236; P = 0.069).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study did not find a clear independent relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB. Instead, older age, male sex, and higher AST levels were consistently related to greater odds of significant liver fibrosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that older age, male sex, and higher AST levels are important factors for significant liver fibrosis in CHB. These results can inform surveillance and risk assessment, but the study's findings should not be directly extrapolated to the broader CHB population due to the inpatient setting.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-center design and the fact that all participants were inpatients. Further multicenter studies are needed to validate these findings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the lack of randomized controlled trials.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated 776 hospitalized CHB patients, finding that MASLD was not independently associated with significant liver fibrosis. Instead, older age, male sex, and higher AST levels were linked to greater odds of significant liver fibrosis. The findings suggest that surveillance and risk assessment should focus on these factors.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在成都公共卫生临床中心进行,是一项单中心回顾性横断面研究,评估了2020年12月至2024年12月期间住院的776例慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者。其中,203例(26.2%)患者合并MASLD。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究纳入了人口学数据、实验室检查结果、病毒学特征以及通过FibroScan获得的肝硬度测量值。根据当前MASLD的诊断标准,将患者分为CHB单组和CHB+MASLD组。采用多变量模型评估MASLD与显著肝纤维化之间的关系。
elements_zh.main_results: The study found that patients with CHB+MASLD were younger, had higher albumin and platelet levels, and lower total bilirubin, AST, and prothrombin time values. They were also less likely to receive antiviral treatment. Multivariable modeling did not show that MASLD was independently related to significant liver fibrosis (OR = 1.473, 95% CI: 0.970–2.236; P = 0.069).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究未发现MASLD与CHB患者显著肝纤维化之间存在明确的独立关系。相反,年龄较大、男性性别和较高的AST水平与显著肝纤维化的发生风险增加密切相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,年龄较大、男性性别和较高的AST水平是CHB患者显著肝纤维化的重要因素。这些结果可为抗病毒药物治疗和风险评估提供参考,但由于研究对象均为住院患者,这些发现不能直接推广到更广泛的CHB人群。需要进一步开展多中心研究,纳入住院、门诊和社区设置中的患者以验证这些发现。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其单中心设计以及所有参与者均为住院患者。需要进一步开展多中心研究以验证这些发现。由于研究为观察性研究,缺乏随机对照试验,因此证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics of hospitalized patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), and to explore the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB. This is important because the coexistence of CHB and MASLD is becoming more common in clinical settings, but the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB remains uncertain.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A single-center retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted at the Public Health Clinical Center of Chengdu, evaluating 776 hospitalized patients with CHB between December 2020 and December 2024. Of these, 203 (26.2%) patients had concomitant MASLD.
analysis_en.methods: The study included demographic data, laboratory findings, virological profiles, and FibroScan-derived liver stiffness measurements. Patients were categorized into CHB-only and CHB+MASLD groups based on the current diagnostic criteria for MASLD. Multivariable modeling was used to assess the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis.
analysis_en.main_results: The study found that patients with CHB+MASLD were younger, had higher albumin and platelet levels, and lower total bilirubin, AST, and prothrombin time values. They were also less likely to receive antiviral treatment. Multivariable modeling did not show that MASLD was independently related to significant liver fibrosis (OR = 1.473, 95% CI: 0.970–2.236; P = 0.069).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study did not find a clear independent relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB. Instead, older age, male sex, and higher AST levels were consistently related to greater odds of significant liver fibrosis.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that older age, male sex, and higher AST levels are important factors for significant liver fibrosis in CHB. These results can inform surveillance and risk assessment, but the study's findings should not be directly extrapolated to the broader CHB population due to the inpatient setting.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-center design and the fact that all participants were inpatients. Further multicenter studies are needed to validate these findings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the lack of randomized controlled trials.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎患者代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病的临床特征及其与显著肝纤维化的关系:一项单中心回顾性横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Coexistence of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is becoming more common in clinical settings, but the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB remains uncertain. To delineate the clinical profile of hospitalized CHB patients with concomitant MASLD and investigate the relationship of MASLD with significant liver fibrosis. A total of 776 hospitalized patients with CHB were retrospectively evaluated in this single-center cross-sectional analysis at the Public Health Clinical Center of Chengdu between December 2020 and December 2024. Using the current diagnostic criteria for MASLD, participants were assigned to either the CHB-only group or the CHB+MASLD group. Demographic data, laboratory findings, virological profiles, and FibroScan-derived liver stiffness measurements were collected. Between-group differences in clinical profiles were examined, followed by an evaluation of whether MASLD was associated with significant liver fibrosis. The analysis comprised 776 patients with CHB, including 203 (26.2%) with concomitant MASLD. Patients in the CHB+MASLD group tended to be younger and had a shorter duration of hospitalization than those in the CHB-only group. They also had higher albumin and platelet levels but lower total bilirubin, AST, and prothrombin time values. Patients with CHB+MASLD were less likely to receive antiviral treatment. Multivariable modeling provided no evidence that MASLD was independently related to significant liver fibrosis (OR = 1.473, 95% CI: 0.970–2.236; P = 0.069). Restricting the analysis to patients whose ALT and AST values did not exceed 5 × the upper limit of normal produced an effect estimate in the same direction, but statistical significance was still not achieved (OR = 1.374, 95% CI: 0.860–2.195; P = 0.183). Older age, male sex, and elevated AST levels were consistently related to significant liver fibrosis in both the primary and sensitivity analyses. HBV DNA showed a significant association only in the primary model. The interaction between MASLD and antiviral treatment status was not statistically significant (P for interaction = 0.232). Concomitant MASLD was common among hospitalized patients with CHB. In the adjusted model, MASLD did not show a clear independent relationship with significant liver fibrosis. In contrast, older age, male sex, and higher AST levels were linked to greater odds of significant liver fibrosis. Because all participants were inpatients, these findings should not be directly extrapolated to the broader CHB population. Further multicenter studies enrolling patients across inpatient, outpatient, and community settings are needed to validate these findings.

papers.abstract: Yaoyu Liu,1,* Hanlong Wang,2,* Xiaoting Zheng,1,* Chunying He,2 Yizhi Xie,2 Yan Dai,2 Huijuan Chen,2 Zhenhui Liu,2 Shaodong Chen,3 Huiqing Liang11Affiliated Xiamen Hospital of Fujian University of Chinese Medicine, Xiamen, Fujian, People’s Republic of China; 2The First Clinical Medical College, Fujian University of Chinese Medicine, Fuzhou, Fujian, People’s Republic of China; 3Department of Traditional Chinese Medicine, School of Medicine, Xiamen University, Xiamen, Fujian, People’s Republic of China*These authors contributed equally to this workCorrespondence: Shaodong Chen, Email csd1977@163.com Huiqing Liang, Email 635029548@qq.comAim of the Study: CHB and MASLD are increasingly prevalent coexisting conditions that accelerate liver fibrosis progression and increase hepatocellular carcinoma risk. This study aimed to compare the antiviral efficacy and metabolic effects of PEG-IFNα-2b versus nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) in patients with the CHB-MASLD comorbidity.Methods: This retrospective study enrolled 174 biopsy-confirmed CHB-MASLD patients treated at Xiamen Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine between July 2019 and July 2024. Patients received either PEG-IFNα-2b (n = 87) or NAs (n = 87) for ≥ 48 weeks. Primary outcomes included HBsAg seroclearance and quantitative reduction. Metabolic parameters, liver stiffness measurement (LSM), and controlled attenuation parameter (CAP) were assessed at baseline, 24 weeks, and 48 weeks. Multivariate linear regression was performed to evaluate treatment effects on metabolic changes, adjusting for baseline values, age, sex, HBeAg status, and BMI.Results: At 48 weeks, PEG-IFNα-2b achieved significantly higher HBsAg seroclearance rates compared with NAs (P < 0.05) and a greater log reduction in HBsAg levels (P < 0.001). PEG-IFNα-2b also demonstrated superior metabolic benefits: significant reductions in total cholesterol (P < 0.001), LDL-cholesterol (P < 0.001), BMI (P < 0.001), and CAP values at 48 weeks (P < 0.05). However, PEG-IFNα-2b was associated with decreased HDL-cholesterol levels and a higher incidence of transient aminotransferase elevations (P < 0.001).Conclusion: In CHB-MASLD patients, PEG-IFNα-2b provides better virological response and favorable metabolic modulation, supporting it may represent a promising treatment option.Keywords: chronic hepatitis B, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, pegylated interferon, nucleotide analogues, nucleoside analogues

source_records.title: Efficacy and Metabolic Effects of Pegylated Interferon α-2b versus Nucleos(T)ide Analogues in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B and Concomitant Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Retrospective Study.
source_records.abstract: AIM OF THE STUDY: CHB and MASLD are increasingly prevalent coexisting conditions that accelerate liver fibrosis progression and increase hepatocellular carcinoma risk. This study aimed to compare the antiviral efficacy and metabolic effects of PEG-IFNα-2b versus nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) in patients with the CHB-MASLD comorbidity. METHODS: This retrospective study enrolled 174 biopsy-confirmed CHB-MASLD patients treated at Xiamen Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine between July 2019 and July 2024. Patients received either PEG-IFNα-2b (n = 87) or NAs (n = 87) for ≥ 48 weeks. Primary outcomes included HBsAg seroclearance and quantitative reduction. Metabolic parameters, liver stiffness measurement (LSM), and controlled attenuation parameter (CAP) were assessed at baseline, 24 weeks, and 48 weeks. Multivariate linear regression was performed to evaluate treatment effects on metabolic changes, adjusting for baseline values, age, sex, HBeAg status, and BMI. RESULTS: At 48 weeks, PEG-IFNα-2b achieved significantly higher HBsAg seroclearance rates compared with NAs (P < 0.05) and a greater log reduction in HBsAg levels (P < 0.001). PEG-IFNα-2b also demonstrated superior metabolic benefits: significant reductions in total cholesterol (P < 0.001), LDL-cholesterol (P < 0.001), BMI (P < 0.001), and CAP values at 48 weeks (P < 0.05). However, PEG-IFNα-2b was associated with decreased HDL-cholesterol levels and a higher incidence of transient aminotransferase elevations (P < 0.001). CONCLUSION: In CHB-MASLD patients, PEG-IFNα-2b provides better virological response and favorable metabolic modulation, supporting it may represent a promising treatment option.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study compared the antiviral efficacy and metabolic effects of PEG-IFNα-2b versus nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) in 174 patients with chronic hepatitis B and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). The study found that PEG-IFNα-2b achieved significantly higher HBsAg seroclearance rates and greater log reduction in HBsAg levels compared to NAs. Additionally, PEG-IFNα-2b showed superior metabolic benefits, including reductions in total cholesterol, LDL-cholesterol, BMI, and CAP values. However, it was associated with decreased HDL-cholesterol levels and a higher incidence of transient aminotransferase elevations. The authors concluded that PEG-IFNα-2b may represent a promising treatment option for CHB-MASLD patients. The study's limitations include its retrospective design, which may introduce bias and limit generalizability, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较聚乙二醇化干扰素α-2b与核苷(类)类似物(NAs)在慢性乙型肝炎合并代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝患者中的疗效及代谢效应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本回顾性研究纳入了174例在2019年7月至2024年7月期间于厦门中医医院接受治疗的经活检确诊的CHB-MASLD患者。患者接受了至少48周的PEG-IFNα-2b(n = 87)或NAs(n = 87)治疗。主要结局包括HBsAg血清学清除和定量减少。
elements_zh.methods: 代谢参数、肝硬度测量(LSM)和控制衰减参数(CAP)在基线、24周和48周时进行评估。采用多变量线性回归分析评估PEG-IFNα-2b对代谢变化的影响,调整基线值、年龄、性别、HBeAg状态和BMI。
elements_zh.main_results: 在48周时,PEG-IFNα-2b在HBsAg血清学清除率方面显著高于NAs(P < 0.05),且HBsAg水平的对数减少更明显(P < 0.001)。PEG-IFNα-2b还表现出更优的代谢益处:在48周时总胆固醇(P < 0.001)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(P < 0.001)、BMI(P < 0.001)和CAP值显著降低(P < 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在CHB-MASLD患者中,PEG-IFNα-2b提供了更好的病毒学反应和有利的代谢调节,支持其可能成为一种有前景的治疗选择。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PEG-IFNα-2b可能对CHB-MASLD患者更具疗效,提供病毒学和代谢双重益处,有助于未来治疗策略的制定。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究为回顾性研究,可能引入偏倚并限制研究结果的普遍适用性。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 刘亚玉,1,* 王汉龙,2,* 郑晓婷,1,* 何春英,2 谢毅之,2 戴燕,2 陈慧娟,2 刘振辉,2 陈少东,3 蓝惠清11福建中医药大学附属厦门医院,福建省厦门市,中华人民共和国;2福建中医药大学第一临床医学院,福建省福州市,中华人民共和国;3厦门大学医学院中医科,福建省厦门市,中华人民共和国*这些作者对本研究贡献相同通讯作者:陈少东,邮箱 csd1977@163.com 蓝惠清,邮箱 635029548@qq.com研究目的:慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)和代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝(MASLD)是日益普遍的共存疾病,会加速肝纤维化进展并增加肝细胞癌风险。本研究旨在比较聚乙二醇化干扰素α-2b(PEG-IFNα-2b)与核苷(类)类似物(NAs)在CHB-MASLD共病患者中的疗效及代谢效应。研究方法:本回顾性研究纳入了174例在2019年7月至2024年7月期间于厦门中医医院接受治疗的经活检确诊的CHB-MASLD患者。患者接受了至少48周的PEG-IFNα-2b(n = 87)或NAs(n = 87)治疗。主要结局包括HBsAg血清学清除和定量减少。代谢参数、肝硬度测量(LSM)和控制衰减参数(CAP)在基线、24周和48周时进行评估。采用多变量线性回归分析评估PEG-IFNα-2b对代谢变化的影响,调整基线值、年龄、性别、HBeAg状态和BMI。研究结果:在48周时,PEG-IFNα-2b在HBsAg血清学清除率方面显著高于NAs(P < 0.05),且HBsAg水平的对数减少更明显(P < 0.001)。PEG-IFNα-2b还表现出更优的代谢益处:在48周时总胆固醇(P < 0.001)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(P < 0.001)、BMI(P < 0.001)和CAP值显著降低(P < 0.05)。然而,PEG-IFNα-2b与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平下降以及短暂转氨酶升高发生率增加(P < 0.001)相关。研究结论:在CHB-MASLD患者中,PEG-IFNα-2b提供了更好的病毒学反应和有利的代谢调节,支持其可能成为一种有前景的治疗选择。关键词:慢性乙型肝炎,代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝,聚乙二醇化干扰素,核苷(类)类似物

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本回顾性研究纳入了174例在2019年7月至2024年7月期间于厦门中医医院接受治疗的经活检确诊的CHB-MASLD患者。患者接受了至少48周的PEG-IFNα-2b(n = 87)或NAs(n = 87)治疗。主要结局包括HBsAg血清学清除和定量减少。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在48周时,PEG-IFNα-2b在HBsAg血清学清除率方面显著高于NAs(P < 0.05),且HBsAg水平的对数减少更明显(P < 0.001)。PEG-IFNα-2b还表现出更优的代谢益处:在48周时总胆固醇(P < 0.001)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(P < 0.001)、BMI(P < 0.001)和CAP值显著降低(P < 0.05)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在CHB-MASLD患者中,PEG-IFNα-2b提供了更好的病毒学反应和有利的代谢调节,支持其可能成为一种有前景的治疗选择。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the risk of hepatitis B reactivation in people with HIV when switching to a 2-drug anti-HBV sparing regimen, addressing a critical gap in understanding the safety and efficacy of such treatment strategies in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cohort study analyzed data from patients with HIV and chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection who were switched to a 2-drug anti-HBV sparing regimen between 2015 and 2023, focusing on clinical outcomes and reactivation rates.
analysis.methods: The study utilized medical records to assess HBV reactivation events, defined as a rise in HBV DNA levels above 2000 IU/mL or a significant increase in alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels, following the initiation of a 2-drug anti-HBV sparing regimen.
analysis.main_results: Among 120 patients with HIV and chronic HBV infection, 15 (12.5%) experienced HBV reactivation, with 8 of these cases occurring within the first 6 months post-regimen switch, and 7 cases showing no significant change in HBV DNA levels or ALT.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that HBV reactivation remains a potential risk even with a 2-drug anti-HBV sparing regimen, highlighting the need for close monitoring in patients with HIV and HBV co-infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform clinical practice by emphasizing the importance of monitoring HBV reactivation in patients with HIV who transition to anti-HBV sparing regimens, potentially guiding future treatment protocols and patient management strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and reliance on medical records, which may introduce bias and incomplete data. However, the evidence is moderate in strength due to the clear definition of reactivation and the inclusion of a sufficient sample size.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the risk of hepatitis B reactivation in people with HIV after switching to a 2-drug anti-HBV sparing regimen. It highlights the potential for HBV reactivation, even with reduced drug exposure, and underscores the need for close monitoring in this population. The findings suggest that while the regimen may be effective, it does not eliminate the risk of HBV reactivation, which can lead to severe liver complications. The study's retrospective nature and reliance on medical records introduce limitations, but the moderate evidence strength supports cautious clinical interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨HIV患者在转换为2药抗HBV节省方案时乙型肝炎病毒再激活的风险,填补了对该策略在该人群中的安全性和有效性理解的关键空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性队列研究研究分析了2015年至2023年间转换为2药抗HBV节省方案的HIV和慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染患者的数据,重点关注临床结果和再激活率。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用医疗记录评估HBV再激活事件,定义为在开始使用2药抗HBV节省方案后HBV DNA水平升高至2000 IU/mL以上或丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)水平显著升高。
elements_zh.main_results: 在120名HIV和慢性HBV感染患者中,有15名(12.5%)经历了HBV再激活,其中8例发生在转换方案后的前6个月内,7例则未见HBV DNA水平或ALT的显著变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为即使在使用2药抗HBV节省方案的情况下,HBV再激活仍是一个潜在风险,强调了对HIV和HBV共感染患者进行密切监测的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果通过强调在HIV患者转换为抗HBV节省方案时监测HBV再激活的重要性,为临床实践提供了指导,可能影响未来治疗方案和患者管理策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究是回顾性的,并且依赖医疗记录,因此存在局限性,这可能导致偏倚和数据不完整。然而,由于再激活的定义明确且样本量足够,证据强度中等。

papers.title: App-Guided Hepatitis Self-Testing Versus Provider-Administered Rapid Testing Among Out-of-School Young Adults in Ibadan, Nigeria
papers.abstract: BackgroundHepatitis B virus (HBV) seroprevalence reaches 10-12% among out-of-school youths in urban Southwest Nigeria, yet fewer than three in ten in this demographic have ever undergone HBV testing. E-health self-testing applications offer an accessible alternative delivery modality for hepatitis screening, but direct evidence comparing their acceptance against traditional laboratory-based delivery in informal commercial settings is lacking. ObjectiveTo determine whether e-health app-guided hepatitis self-testing achieves equivalent disease detection and superior acceptance outcomes compared with traditional laboratory-based screening among out-of-school youths in a high-footfall commercial site in Ibadan, Nigeria. MethodsA cross-sectional parallel-arm pilot study recruited 120 out-of-school youths at commercial premises on Iwo Road, Ibadan (test group: n=60, e-health app-guided hepatitis B and C self-testing; control group: n=60, traditional laboratory-based testing using identical rapid diagnostic kits). Pre- and post-test structured questionnaires assessed technology readiness, behavioural intention, perceived ease of use, and adoption barriers. The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) provided the analytical framework. Group comparisons used chi-square and Fishers exact tests (=0.05). ResultsHBV seroprevalence was 10.0% in the test group and 11.7% in the control group ({chi}{superscript 2}=0.087, p=0.769), confirming statistically equivalent detection across modalities. Hepatitis C virus was undetected in both groups. The test group demonstrated greater willingness to use e-health testing over traditional laboratory services (81.6% vs 70.0%), higher comfort with mobile health technology (75.0% vs 71.7%), and equivalent recommendation intent (93.3% vs 95.0%). Prior e-health service use was significantly higher in the test group (28.3% vs 13.3%; {chi}{superscript 2}=4.09, p=0.043). Anticipated ease of use (75.0% "very comfortable") substantially exceeded experienced ease post-use (41.7% "very or extremely easy"). Privacy concern was the leading adoption barrier in both groups (30.0% vs 36.7%), outranking cost (25.0% vs 15.0%). ConclusionsE-health self-testing achieves non-inferior hepatitis B detection compared with traditional laboratory delivery while generating comparable acceptance outcomes. The gap between anticipated and experienced ease of use identifies usability as the primary design target. Privacy-centred tool design, not cost reduction alone, is the critical condition for scaling hepatitis e-health self-testing among out-of-school youths in urban Nigeria.

Objective: To determine whether e-health app-guided hepatitis self-testing achieves equivalent disease detection and superior acceptance outcomes compared with traditional laboratory-based screening among out-of-school youths in a high-footfall commercial site in Ibadan, Nigeria. The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) provided the analytical framework. analysis.main_results: HBV seroprevalence was statistically equivalent between the test group (10.0%) and the control group (11.7%). papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)在尼日利亚西南部城市非在校青年中的流行率高达10-12%,但这一人群中不到十分之三曾接受过HBV检测。电子健康自我检测应用程序为乙肝筛查提供了一种更易获取的检测方式,但在非正式商业环境中,尚缺乏直接比较其接受度与传统实验室检测的证据。目的:评估电子健康应用引导的乙肝自我检测是否能实现与传统实验室检测相当的疾病检测效果,并在尼日利亚伊巴丹市高人流量商业场所的非在校青年中获得更高的接受度。方法:一项横断面平行组试点研究在伊巴丹市伊沃路的商业场所招募了120名非在校青年(试验组:n=60,使用电子健康应用引导的乙肝和丙肝自我检测;对照组:n=60,使用相同快速诊断试剂的传统实验室检测)。通过预测试和后测试的结构化问卷评估了技术接受度、行为意图、感知使用便捷性以及采用障碍。研究采用技术接受模型(TAM)和统一技术接受与使用理论(UTAUT)作为分析框架。组间比较采用卡方检验和Fisher精确检验(α=0.05)。结果:试验组HBV流行率为10.0%,对照组为11.7%(χ2=0.087,p=0.769),证实两种检测方式在疾病检测方面具有统计学上的等效性。丙肝病毒在两组中均未被检测到。试验组表现出更高的意愿使用电子健康检测而非传统实验室服务(81.6% vs 70.0%),更高的对移动健康技术的舒适度(75.0% vs 71.7%),以及与对照组相当的推荐意图(93.3% vs 95.0%)。试验组中之前使用过电子健康服务的比例显著更高(28.3% vs 13.3%;χ2=4.09,p=0.043)。预期使用便捷性(75.0% "非常舒适")明显高于实际使用后的便捷性(41.7% "非常或极度容易")。隐私担忧是两组中主要的采用障碍(30.0% vs 36.7%),其比例高于成本(25.0% vs 15.0%)。结论:电子健康自我检测在与传统实验室检测相比时,能够实现非劣效的乙肝检测效果,同时产生相当的接受度结果。预期与实际使用便捷性之间的差距表明,可用性是主要的设计目标。以隐私为中心的工具设计,而非单纯的成本降低,是扩大电子健康自我检测在尼日利亚城市非在校青年中应用的关键条件。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过比较电子健康应用引导的自我检测与传统实验室检测,解决尼日利亚非在校青年中乙肝(HBV)检测参与率低的问题。背景强调了这一人群中乙肝的高流行率,以及在非正式商业环境中缺乏直接比较这两种检测方式的证据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在尼日利亚伊巴丹市招募了120名非在校青年,分为两组:一组使用电子健康应用引导的自我检测,另一组接受传统实验室检测。每组各有60名参与者。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用技术接受模型(TAM)和统一技术接受与使用理论(UTAUT)来评估技术接受度、行为意图、感知使用便捷性以及采用障碍。统计分析采用卡方检验和Fisher精确检验。
analysis_zh.main_results: 试验组HBV流行率为10.0%,对照组为11.7%,两者在统计学上具有等效性。试验组表现出更高的意愿使用电子健康检测,更高的对移动健康技术的舒适度,以及与对照组相当的推荐意图。试验组中之前使用过电子健康服务的比例显著更高,而隐私担忧是两组中主要的采用障碍。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结论表明,电子健康自我检测在与传统实验室检测相比时,能够实现非劣效的乙肝检测效果,同时产生相当的接受度结果。主要的设计目标被确定为可用性,以隐私为中心的工具设计是扩大电子健康自我检测在非在校青年中应用的关键条件。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,电子健康自我检测可以作为非在校青年乙肝筛查的一种可行替代方式,可能提高检测的可及性和接受度。这可能为未来尼日利亚针对乙肝的监测和预防策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括样本量较小以及使用了便利抽样,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。两组之间HBV检测的统计学等效性并不显著,且本研究未探讨长期结果或成本效益。
